craft_notes: Sthāyin: bind-joy. daśānāmapi fused; yojayet (yoke) vs kārayet. Close: making. Rejected: 'all directions' spelled — kept 'of the ten'.

lines: of the ten, let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām ekaikaṃ tu diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānāmapi yojayet |

reads_against.argmap: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered — with each one the ten quarters' binding.
c1_essence: Placing done, topknot bound; all ten quarters bound.
